subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should this PR land the stricter fail-closed channel read-target boundary and Google Chat reaction removal as the default behavior for existing users?
rationale: The patch closes a real authorization boundary, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for users who relied on provider-visible cross-conversation reads or Google Chat reaction actions.

options.title: Accept the stricter boundary
options.body: Land the current approach after final CI because it fixes the authorization gap and documents the compatibility impact.

options.title: Stage compatibility more narrowly
options.body: Require a smaller follow-up shape that preserves more existing read or Google Chat behavior until maintainers approve each fail-closed case.

options.title: Pause for alternate branch comparison
options.body: Keep this PR open only as comparison material if maintainers prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98972 as the canonical implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept the stricter boundary
recommendation.body: Land the current approach after final CI because it fixes the authorization gap and documents the compatibility impact.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant owns the active branch and latest repair commits, so they are the best available person to coordinate the security/compatibility choice.
